8786f41b62711779.description: نبذة عن الشركة والدور TruckMate Information Technology هي منشأة سعودية تقنية مقرها الدمام، متخصصة في تطوير نظام ERP متكامل لشركات النقل والخدمات اللوجستية. يغطي النظام جوانب متعددة مثل إسناد الرحلات، التتبع المباشر للأسطول، سندات التسليم الإلكترونية، إدارة الورشة وقطع الغيار، والموارد البشرية والرواتب. تبحث الشركة عن مندوب مبيعات ميداني للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينتي الدمام والرياض، بخبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. مهام الوظيفة يتولى مندوب المبيعات الميداني مسؤولية تعريف الشركات المستهدفة بنظام TruckMate ومتابعتها حتى إتمام توقيع العقود. تشمل المهام الرئيسية ما يلي: بناء قائمة بالشركات المستهدفة في المنطقة المحددة، والوصول إلى صناع القرار فيها. زيارة الشركات ميدانياً لفهم طريقة إدارتها لأسطولها وعملياتها. ترتيب وتقديم عروض تجريبية للنظام بدعم من فريق TruckMate. متابعة العملاء المحتملين حتى مرحلة التفاوض وتوقيع العقد. تسجيل الزيارات والعملاء في سجل المتابعة، وإرسال تقرير يومي مختصر. تحقيق المستهدفات الأسبوعية من الزيارات والعروض التجريبية. نقل ملاحظات العملاء من الميدان للمساهمة في تطوير النظام. المؤهلات والمتطلبات لشغل هذا الدور، يجب أن تتوفر في المرشح المؤهلات والمتطلبات التالية: خبرة في المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع النقل أو الخدمات اللوجستية أو مبيعات الأنظمة. وجود علاقات مع شركات نقل أو مقاولات أو توزيع يعتبر ميزة إضافية. رخصة قيادة سارية وسيارة خاصة. القدرة على العمل باستقلالية في الميدان. طبيعة العمل والمزايا تتميز طبيعة العمل بالمرونة، حيث يتم توثيق العقد عبر منصة قوى. يوفر الدور عمولة مجزية على كل عقد يتم توقيعه، مع دخل مفتوح بدون سقف، وحرية في تنظيم الوقت وجدول الزيارات. كما يتم توفير تدريب كامل على النظام، وحساب تجريبي للعروض، وملفات تعريفية جاهزة لدعم مندوب المبيعات. تفاصيل إضافية هذا الدور متاح بنظام العقد، ويقدم راتباً يتراوح بين 5,625 ريال سعودي و 7,500 ريال سعودي.

87bddfb49129d982.description: About the role The Senior Dealer is the operational lead for an assigned dealing shift and the first escalation point for complex trades, portfolio-risk events and client trading issues. In addition to hands-on dealing, this role directs live shift activity, monitors team performance and attendance, and coordinates cover so that dealing operations remain staffed and controlled. The Senior Dealer works closely with the Head of Dealing across three daily shifts supporting the Saudi and global markets, with particular focus on U.S. market activity. Shift leadership and staffing continuity Own end-to-end readiness, staffing, service standards and operational execution for the assigned shift; confirm attendance, desk allocation and staff availability at the start of and throughout the shift. Arrange break cover and respond to late arrivals, unplanned absence or unexpected workload; reallocate work or step in personally to fill immediate coverage gaps, coordinating with the Head of Dealing. Ensure no dealing desk or assigned shift is left unattended during required market coverage; flag forecast staffing shortfalls early and request backup support. Lead structured shift handovers, including open orders, margin actions, live risk exposures, client escalations, market events and unresolved technology incidents. Check operational readiness for Saudi and U.S. sessions, including relevant trading calendars, exchange holidays and U.S. daylight-saving changes. Trade supervision and escalation management Supervise dealers’ live order monitoring and execution quality across supported Saudi and international products, especially U.S. equities, ETFs and listed options. Handle escalated trade exceptions, complex order issues, sensitive client inquiries and broker/execution problems; execute trades directly when needed. Oversee application of buying-power, margin, concentration and trading-limit controls; prioritize material accounts and coordinate action with Risk and Compliance. Manage significant market-volatility events, options exercise/assignment concerns and urgent margin cases under approved escalation and approval frameworks. Coordinate immediate incident response for execution errors or platform disruption, preserving records and escalating critical issues to the Head of Dealing. Team performance and operational improvement Monitor shift performance, case queues, response times, control adherence and dealer productivity; provide real-time coaching and quality feedback. Support onboarding, cross-training, procedure refreshers and daily briefings so dealers are prepared for product and market-session requirements. Produce concise shift reports covering staffing, incidents, outstanding exceptions, material risks and follow-up owners. Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Client Services to reduce recurring trade-support issues and strengthen shift playbooks. CME-3 (CMA) certification and Tadawul Certificate — both required. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline; typically 5+ years of relevant brokerage, dealing or trading-operations experience. Proven hands-on experience in the Saudi market and international markets, especially U.S. equities and options; deep knowledge of the products, order lifecycle, exchange sessions and margin-risk dynamics. Demonstrated ability to lead a live trading desk or shift, supervise colleagues, prioritize risk and make sound decisions under market pressure. Strong command of OMS/trading systems, exception management, audit-quality records, stakeholder coordination and operational incident handling. Fluent professional English, written and spoken, with confident client escalation and team communication skills. Availability for rotating schedules, regular night shifts and urgent coverage when needed to maintain uninterrupted operations.

87d587f8716336d9.description: About the Role ECEC East Consulting Engineering Company is seeking an experienced ELV Engineer to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. 8722860751f18501.description: About the Role DP World Jeddah is seeking an Advanced Yard Planner to join its Planning team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role is responsible for developing strategic yard plans and optimization recommendations to enhance terminal operations. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose and Impact The Advanced Yard Planner develops forward-looking yard plans, capacity forecasts, and optimization recommendations. This involves aligning yard strategy with vessel schedules, gate demand, inventory, and equipment capabilities. The role focuses on improving planning parameters, allocation strategies, anticipating congestion, reducing re-handles, and supporting data-driven continuous improvement across terminal operations. Key Responsibilities Prepare forward-looking yard plans for vessels expected within 24–72 hours and maintain a rolling view of upcoming vessel volumes, gate demand, inventory, and available capacity. Develop allocation strategies for various cargo types, including import, export, transshipment, empty, reefer, IMDG, OOG, and special cargo, ensuring compliance with approved yard strategy, segregation requirements, and SOPs. Forecast yard utilization, block occupancy, stacking density, and capacity pressure by block and time period, identifying risks early and proposing mitigation plans. Coordinate with Vessel Planners to align yard plans with vessel schedules, stowage and loading sequences, POD, container size, weight class, and cargo-specific requirements. Design and refine allocation approaches across RTG/AeRTG/ECH and other applicable blocks, balancing capacity, equipment capability, workload, accessibility, and expected cargo flows. Analyze re-handle ratios, housekeeping moves, mixed stacks, dwell time, gate demand, and yard-related vessel delays to identify root causes and develop measurable improvement actions. Review yard planning filters, groups, ranges, stacking rules, and TOS parameters, collaborating with the Yard Strategist and IT/TOS teams to test and improve automated and manual planning processes. Develop planning scenarios for peak volumes, high yard utilization, empty-container surges, equipment constraints, and changes to vessel schedules, recommending practical contingency plans. Establish and maintain planning reports, forecasts, and dashboards to support decisions on yard capacity, cargo allocation, reefer plug requirements, and operational performance. Review long-staying containers, overstays, and empty inventory trends with relevant teams and shipping lines, assessing their impact on future capacity and recommending actions. Define and communicate yard planning standards, allocation principles, and handover requirements, supporting knowledge sharing and consistent planning practices across shifts. Support TOS upgrades, user acceptance testing, planning-system enhancements, and continuous improvement projects, documenting requirements, test outcomes, and recommended changes. Provide supervisors and management with clear analysis of capacity risks, plan deviations, root causes, proposed actions, and expected operational benefits. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in yard planning and container terminal operations. Demonstrated ability to contribute to operational excellence. Application Process Candidates with relevant experience in yard planning and container terminal operations are encouraged to apply.

87336cb1ff38c265.description: Job description Job description: Operations & Maintenance Technician / Engineer Job purpose: The Operations & Maintenance Technician / Engineer is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation and maintenance of Envac pneumatic waste collection systems. The role supports planned preventive maintenance, corrective repairs, troubleshooting, inspections, system monitoring, spare-parts control, and customer/site support to maintain high system availability. Key Responsibilities Operate and monitor Envac pneumatic waste collection systems, including collection stations, inlet stations, pneumatic equipment, electrical controls, and associated mechanical components. Perform routine, preventive, and proactive maintenance in accordance with approved maintenance schedules, technical manuals, and site-specific procedures. Envac documentation emphasizes routine, preventive, and proactive maintenance as core operational requirements. Diagnose and rectify mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control-system faults; respond to breakdowns promptly to minimize downtime. Conduct regular inspections, functional testing, and condition assessments; identify defects and ensure repairs are completed within required timeframes. Carry out authorized electrical and pneumatic work, commissioning support, and initial start-up activities in accordance with Envac procedures. Maintain accurate service records, inspection reports, maintenance checklists, fault reports, and technical documentation. Use computerized maintenance and control systems to track work orders, equipment performance, maintenance history, and service activities. Monitor and maintain appropriate stock levels of critical spare parts, consumables, tools, and materials. Support scheduled replacement of worn or failed components and recommend improvements to maintenance plans, equipment reliability, and system performance. Ensure all work is performed in compliance with Envac requirements, site procedures, applicable legislation, and HSE standards. Apply safe isolation procedures before maintenance, including isolation of electrical power and compressed air, lockout/tagout, and use of appropriate PPE. Documentation requires compressed air to be turned off before work on pneumatically operated equipment and safety switches isolated before electrical work. Coordinate professionally with clients, facilities-management teams, subcontractors, and internal operations teams; provide technical guidance and site updates where required. Participate in shift work, on-call duty, emergency call-outs, and weekend/public-holiday coverage as required by the site operation. Envac is seeking a safety-focused and technically capable Operations & Maintenance Technician / Engineer to support the reliable operation of advanced pneumatic waste collection systems. The successful candidate will combine hands-on electro-mechanical maintenance capability with strong troubleshooting skills, disciplined documentation, and a commitment to excellent customer service and continuous improvement. Skills Skills Required Qualifications and Experience Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Alternatively, a recognized technical/vocational qualification with relevant hands-on operations and maintenance experience. Typically 2–5 years of experience in maintenance, facilities operations, industrial automation, pneumatic conveying, waste-management systems, utilities, or comparable electro-mechanical systems. Hands-on experience in fault-finding and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control equipment. Experience with PLC-controlled systems, sensors, actuators, motors, fans, compressors, valves, VFDs, and industrial electrical panels is strongly preferred. Familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), work-order management, and technical reporting. Valid driving licence is preferred, subject to site and local requirements. Required Technical Skills Strong practical knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, P&IDs, manuals, equipment layouts, and maintenance procedures. Competence in systematic troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action follow-up. Ability to perform inspections, servicing, adjustment, replacement, and functional testing of equipment. Understanding of preventive and condition-based maintenance practices. Knowledge of spare-parts identification, inventory control, and maintenance planning. Basic computer skills, including MS Office and maintenance/reporting systems. Knowledge of safe work practices, permit-to-work systems, lockout/tagout, and risk assessment. Required Personal Skills Strong safety mindset, attention to detail, and ability to follow procedures consistently. Proactive, dependable, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team. Calm and methodical approach to breakdown response and time-critical troubleshooting. Good communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage for Qatar-based roles. Customer-focused approach with professional site conduct. Physically capable of working in industrial environments, including exposure to noise, moving equipment, confined or restricted spaces, and outdoor conditions, subject to medical fitness requirements. Willingness to undertake Envac-specific technical and safety training. Envac component guidance specifies that maintenance procedures must be completed by trained personnel or personnel with solid experience handling the relevant components. Preferred Certifications Electrical authorization or electrical safety certification. NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA, or equivalent HSE certification. First Aid and Fire Safety training. Confined Space Entry, Working at Height, LOTO, and Permit-to-Work training. PLC, industrial automation, pneumatic systems, or mechanical maintenance certifications.

872f51ba3e262e21.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة [اسم الشركة محجوب من قبل صاحب العمل] عن ممثلة خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وتقديم الدعم اللازم لهم في مجال الأثاث، بهدف تحسين تجربتهم ومساعدتهم في اختيار المنتجات المناسبة. تتراوح الخبرة المطلوبة لهذا المنصب من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية التفاعل مع العملاء عبر الهاتف والبريد الإلكتروني لتقديم الدعم والإجابة على استفساراتهم حول منتجات الأثاث. تسجيل تفاصيل الشكاوى والملاحظات الخاصة بالعملاء في النظام المخصص. تقديم معلومات دقيقة وشاملة حول خدمات الشركة ومنتجاتها. التنسيق مع الفرق الداخلية لحل القضايا المعقدة للعملاء بفعالية. تطوير علاقات إيجابية ومستمرة مع العملاء لتعزيز ولائهم. تقديم تغذية راجعة للإدارة حول مشاكل العملاء واقتراحات التحسين. المشاركة في برامج التدريب والتطوير المستمر لتعزيز المهارات المهنية. تتبع وتوثيق جميع التفاعلات مع العملاء بدقة في السجلات المخصصة. المساهمة في تحقيق أهداف الفريق من خلال تقديم خدمة عملاء متميزة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التواصل بوضوح وفعالية مع العملاء. مهارات حل المشكلات والتعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى العملاء. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي. بيئة العمل تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تشجع على التعاون والابتكار. يتم تقديم فرص التدريب والتطوير المستمر للموظفين، بالإضافة إلى إمكانية الوصول إلى موارد تعليمية متقدمة لتعزيز المهارات المهنية واكتساب خبرة قيمة في صناعة الأثاث. هذا الدور هو بدوام كامل. الموقع ونوع العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل. نطاق الراتب يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا المنصب بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي.
